```json
      "EvidenceComparisonSource": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Coverage and freshness of one selected original source.",
        "properties": {

            "description": "Original authority.",
            "type": "string"
          },

            "type": "string"
          },

          },

            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "freshness": {
            "description": "Freshness against explicit owner observations only.",
            "type": "string"
          },

          },

          "expected_members",

        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "EvidenceComparisonSummary": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Full selected populations. Missing execution and mixed outcomes are independent\naxes and may overlap failure classifications.",
        "properties": {
          "ambiguous": {
            "description": "Duplicate owner identities within a source or unavailable exact identity.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "changed_selection_denominator": {
            "description": "Full selected test-row counts differ.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "inconclusive": {
            "description": "Unknown or mixed change evidence without an eligible change verdict.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "mixed_outcome_cohorts": {
            "description": "Cohorts with original failure and success evidence.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "new_failures": {
            "description": "Candidate failures following an all-success baseline.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "paired": {
            "description": "Subjects paired by exact identity or supplied mapping.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "persistent_failures": {
            "description": "Failure evidence in both sides, retaining mixed outcomes.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "resolved_failures": {
            "description": "Baseline failures followed by an all-success candidate.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "selection_membership_changed_or_unresolved": {
            "description": "Unmatched or ambiguous cohorts prevent a same-subject selection claim.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "unchanged_successes": {
            "description": "Compatible pairs with only explicit successes.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unexecuted": {
            "description": "Pairs lacking execution in either side.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unmatched_baseline": {
            "description": "Baseline-only cohorts.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unmatched_candidate": {
            "description": "Candidate-only cohorts.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "paired",
          "new_failures",
          "resolved_failures",
          "persistent_failures",
          "unexecuted",
          "inconclusive",
          "unchanged_successes",
          "unmatched_baseline",
          "unmatched_candidate",
          "ambiguous",
          "mixed_outcome_cohorts",
          "changed_selection_denominator",
          "selection_membership_changed_or_unresolved"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "EvidenceFact": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "One compact authentic owner fact, without raw bytes or a lifetime grant.",

            "description": "Compact owner-declared binary id; absent means unknown.",

              "null"
            ]
          },

            "description": "Compact owner-declared context id; absent means unknown.",
            "type": [

              "null"
            ]
          },

            "description": "Compact owner-declared context json; absent means unknown.",

              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "crate_name": {
            "description": "Declared owning crate, if available.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "detail_ref": {
            "description": "Descriptive owner reference, never an automatic path or grant.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "kind": {
            "description": "Owner-declared category.",

          },
          "link_relation": {

            ]
          },
          "link_target": {
            "description": "Compact owner-declared link target; absent means unknown.",

              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "member": {

            "type": "string"
          },
          "population_id": {
            "description": "Compact owner-declared population id; absent means unknown.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "sample_id": {
            "description": "Compact owner-declared sample id; absent means unknown.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "status": {
            "description": "Original outcome, including unreported/command failures.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "test_id": {
            "description": "Exact Rust binary/test identity or Python node ID, if available.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "value_ns": {
            "description": "Compact owner-declared value ns; absent means unknown.",

            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [

          "kind",
          "status"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "EvidenceMeasurementCohortOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Descriptive statistics and membership counts of one original measurement cohort.",
        "properties": {
          "censored_populations": {
            "description": "Original censored or unmeasured population declarations.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,

            ]
          },

          },

            "minimum": 0,

        "type": "object"
      },
      "EvidenceMeasurementComparisonOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Paired or honestly unpaired original measurement cohorts.",
        "properties": {
          "association": {
            "description": "Explicit scope of supported original association.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "baseline": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/EvidenceMeasurementCohortOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Baseline descriptor only when exactly one original cohort exists."
          },
          "baseline_cohorts": {
            "description": "Baseline original cohorts before display bounds.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "candidate": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/EvidenceMeasurementCohortOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Candidate descriptor only when exactly one original cohort exists."
          },
          "candidate_cohorts": {
            "description": "Candidate original cohorts before display bounds.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "changed_fields": {
            "description": "Relevant declared conditions that differ.",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "conditions": {
            "description": "Comparable conditions, incompatible conditions, or unavailable basis.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "correspondence": {
            "description": "Exact compatible owner identity or explicitly supplied mapping.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "revision_build": {
            "description": "Revision/build interpretation retained with the assessment.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "unknown_fields": {
            "description": "Relevant conditions not declared by at least one original owner.",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "verdict": {
            "description": "Descriptive-only verdict; statistical and causal conclusions are not inferred.",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "correspondence",
          "baseline_cohorts",
          "candidate_cohorts",
          "baseline",
          "candidate",
          "conditions",
          "changed_fields",
          "unknown_fields",
          "association",
          "verdict",
          "revision_build"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "EvidenceMeasurementSummary": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Cross-side measurement compatibility counts, retaining inconclusive cohorts.",
        "properties": {
          "comparable": {
            "description": "Pairs with declared and equal relevant conditions; sample association remains separate.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "incompatible": {
            "description": "Pairs with at least one different declared condition.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "populations": {
            "description": "Exact owner/population cohorts examined across both sides.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unavailable": {
            "description": "Missing/unknown conditions, absent samples, ambiguity or unpaired populations.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unavailable_association_populations": {
            "description": "Cohorts lacking any declared association or reporting unavailable/unsupported association.\nThis axis is independent of condition compatibility.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "verdict": {
            "description": "No automatic regression, causality or flakiness verdict is produced.",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "populations",
          "comparable",
          "incompatible",
          "unavailable",
          "unavailable_association_populations",
          "verdict"
        ],
```

```json
          "BackendSettingsBody": {
            "description": "Typed backend settings of a request. Each variant is its adapter's pse-owned settings\ntype (`crate::settings`), present in every build, and identity derives from serde, never\nfrom a hand-written field list (F09). The document form is tagged by the registry\n`backend` spelling; the routed backend's native defaults have no document form, so a\ndocument states them by omitting its settings.               {
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Ipopt linear solver with its parameters, barrier strategy and initial-point push.",
                "properties": {
                  "backend": {
                    "const": "ipopt",
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "bound_frac": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/Fraction",
                    "default": 0.01,
                    "description": "Minimum relative distance of a cold initial point from its bounds (`bound_frac`);\nadmission refuses more than one half, Ipopt's registered range."

                    "$ref": "#/$defs/Tolerance",
                    "default": 0.01,
                    "description": "Minimum absolute distance of a cold initial point from its bounds (`bound_push`)."
                  },
                  "linear": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/IpoptLinear",
                    "default": {
                      "kind": "mumps",
                      "maximum_pivot_tolerance": 0.1,
                      "memory_percent": 1000,
                      "ordering": "metis",
                      "permuting_scaling": 7,
                      "pivot_tolerance": 1e-06
                    },
                    "description": "Symmetric-indefinite factorization of the KKT systems."
                  },
                  "mu_strategy": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/MuStrategy",
                    "default": "monotone",
                    "description": "Barrier-parameter update strategy (`mu_strategy`)."
                  },
                  "restart": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/WarmRestart",
                    "default": {
                      "barrier": {
                        "kind": "seed"
                      },
                      "bound_frac": 1e-09,
                      "bound_push": 1e-09,
                      "mult_bound_push": 1e-09,
                      "slack_bound_frac": 1e-09,
                      "slack_bound_push": 1e-09

                    "description": "Restart of a submitted primal-dual seed: barrier and pushes (L-N3)."
```

```json
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "database": {
        "minLength": 1,
        "title": "Database",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "request": {
        "$ref": "urn:pse:boundary:f87d518034ebfe00547f6b32a106482848453ec8145b40691ca8e2cfb9bf0a44:result-inspection-request:input"
      },
      "resources": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Resources"
      },
      "state": {
        "minLength": 1,
        "title": "State",
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "state",
      "database",
      "request"
    ],
    "title": "ResultInspection",
    "type": "object"
  },
  "name": "native_result_inspect",
  "outputSchema": {
    "$defs": {
      "ArrowFieldPath": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Exact typed Arrow navigation; an empty step list selects the original root field.",
        "properties": {
          "field": {
            "description": "Exact original root column name.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "steps": {
            "description": "At most sixteen native struct/list operations.",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/ArrowFieldStep"
            },
            "type": "array"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "field",
          "steps"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "ArrowFieldStep": {
        "description": "A native array operation, not a JSON pointer or a string expression.",
        "oneOf": [
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "Exact declared struct child.",
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "const": "struct_field",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "name": {
                "description": "Original exact child name.",
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "name"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "Selected element relative to each original row's list offsets.",
            "properties": {
              "index": {
                "description": "Zero-based position within each original valid list.",
                "format": "uint64",
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "kind": {
                "const": "list_element",
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "index"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          }
        ]
      },
      "BasisKind": {
        "enum": [
          "molar",
          "mass",
          "volume",
          "energy",
          "standard_volume",
          "dimensionless"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "CompositionBasis": {
        "enum": [
          "mole_fraction",
          "mass_fraction",
          "volume_fraction",
          "molality",
          "molarity"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "DimensionVector": {
        "description": "Rational exponents over the eight base dimensions (blueprint §4.4, §8.1).\n\nThe slots are indexed by [`BaseDimension`] and stored in its ordinal order, which is\nalso the order of the `FixedSizeList<Struct<num, den>, 8>` storage of\n`pse.dimension_vector`.\n\nDimension arithmetic is *not* physical typing: `dimensionless` is the dimension of a\nmole fraction and of a Reynolds number alike, and two quantities with the same\ndimension vector may still be incompatible (§8.1). This type answers only the\ndimensional half; the complete answer is a `QuantityType`.\n\n```\nuse pse_quantity::{BaseDimension, DimensionVector, Ratio};\n\nlet velocity = DimensionVector::base(BaseDimension::Length)\n    .div(&DimensionVector::base(BaseDimension::Time))?;\nassert_eq!(velocity.exponent(BaseDimension::Length), Ratio::ONE);\nassert_eq!(velocity.to_string(), \"L·T^-1\");\n# Ok::<(), pse_quantity::DimensionError>(())\n```",
        "items": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Ratio"
        },
        "maxItems": 8,
        "minItems": 8,
        "type": "array"
      },
      "KindDefinition": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "What a derived kind is (ADR-0124): a monomial of other kinds, its declared canonical\nunit, and the complete result a multiplicative chain resolving to it takes. Kinds are\ndeclared, never synthesized.",
        "properties": {
          "basis": {
            "description": "Declared result basis. Without one, every basis-carrying chain factor must agree.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "x-pse-identity": "BasisId"
          },
          "canonical_unit": {
            "description": "The canonical unit every quantity type of this kind stores in.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "UnitId"
          },
          "monomial": {
            "description": "Factors over declared kinds; admission expands derived factors, so the admitted\nmonomial is over base kinds in identity order.",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/KindFactor"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "reference_state": {
            "description": "Declared result datum.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "x-pse-identity": "ReferenceStateId"
          },
          "scale_kind": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ScaleKind",
            "description": "Declared result scale."
          },
          "subject_kind": {
            "description": "Declared result subject.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "x-pse-identity": "EntityKindId"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "monomial",
          "canonical_unit",
          "basis",
          "reference_state",
          "scale_kind",
          "subject_kind"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "KindFactor": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "One factor of a kind monomial: a kind and its nonzero rational exponent.",
        "properties": {
          "exponent": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Ratio",
            "description": "Its nonzero rational exponent."
          },
          "kind": {
            "description": "The factor kind.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "QuantityKindId"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "kind",
          "exponent"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "PackResultPredicateOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Exact protected output predicate. Floating endpoints retain IEEE bits, not JSON rounding.",
        "properties": {
          "maximum_bits": {
            "description": "Optional upper predicate endpoint as exact IEEE-754 bits.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "minimum_bits": {
            "description": "Optional lower predicate endpoint as exact IEEE-754 bits.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "missing": {
            "description": "Original missing-value predicate, independent of empty output.",
            "type": [
              "boolean",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "output": {
            "description": "Original scientific output owner identity.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "partition": {
            "description": "Exact original selected output partition.",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "output",
          "partition",
          "minimum_bits",
          "maximum_bits",
          "missing"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "PackResultSelectionOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Exact original result lineage and range, including independent usability.",
        "properties": {
          "attempt": {
            "description": "Exact original attempt identity; retries never substitute another attempt.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "field": {
            "description": "Optional original field/output selection; schema remains the original typed relation.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "predicate": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/PackResultPredicateOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "default": null,
            "description": "Exact original output predicate; absent for the whole selected relation."
          },
          "relation": {
            "description": "Qualified original registry relation name.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "row_end": {
            "description": "Exclusive original row coordinate, before selected filtering.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "row_start": {
            "description": "Inclusive original row coordinate, before selected filtering.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "run": {
            "description": "Original canonical run identity; never a current-run alias.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "schema_version": {
            "description": "Original registry relation schema version, independent of IPC transport encoding.",
            "format": "uint32",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "terminal_class": {
            "description": "Original closed attempt classification, independent of publication.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "usability": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/PackScientificState",
            "description": "Original scientific product usability, never upgraded by copying."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "run",
          "attempt",
          "relation",
          "schema_version",
          "row_start",
          "row_end",
          "field",
          "terminal_class",
          "predicate",
          "usability"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "PackScientificState": {
        "description": "Scientific usability recorded by the producer; publication never upgrades it.",
        "oneOf": [
          {
            "const": "unknown",
            "description": "Original scientific usability was not established.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "const": "usable",
            "description": "Original authority admitted this selected product as usable.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "const": "partial",
            "description": "Original selected scientific product has partial coverage.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "const": "failed",
            "description": "Original scientific work failed; export may still complete.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "const": "unusable",
            "description": "Original product is retained but lacks scientific use permission.",
            "type": "string"
          }
        ]
      },
      "PhysicalBasis": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "A declared material or specific-quantity basis.",
        "properties": {
          "composition_basis": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/CompositionBasis"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Optional composition convention."
          },
          "id": {
            "description": "Registry identity.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "BasisId"
          },
          "kind": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/BasisKind",
            "description": "What this quantity is per."
          },
          "rate_basis": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/RateBasis"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Optional rate convention."
          },
          "reference_conditions": {
            "description": "Conditions required for a standard-volume basis.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "x-pse-identity": "ReferenceStateId"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "kind",
          "composition_basis",
          "rate_basis",
          "reference_conditions"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "PhysicalEntityKind": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "A declared kind used as a physical axis or subject.",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "description": "Stable authored identity.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "EntityKindId"
          },
          "name": {
            "description": "Qualified inspection name; identity comparisons use `id`.",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "name"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "PhysicalInspectionDocumentBody": {
        "description": "One immutable context page. An extent refusal never returns truncated meaning.",
        "oneOf": [
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "Complete selected declarations with their actual immutable context identity.",
            "properties": {
              "context": {
                "description": "Exact physical context that interpreted every record.",
                "pattern": "^blake3:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$",
                "type": "string",
                "x-pse-identity": "ContentHash"
              },
              "count": {
                "description": "Complete selected population, independent of the current page.",
                "format": "uint",
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "kind": {
                "const": "page",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "next": {
                "description": "Next original offset; each call reacquires any canonical protection.",
                "format": "uint",
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": [
                  "integer",
                  "null"
                ]
              },
              "offset": {
                "description": "Original offset.",
                "format": "uint",
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "quantities": {
                "description": "Selected quantity records, in stable identity order.",
                "items": {
                  "$ref": "#/$defs/PhysicalQuantityDescription"
                },
                "type": "array"
              },
              "reference_states": {
                "description": "Selected named reference-state records.",
                "items": {
                  "$ref": "#/$defs/ReferenceState"
                },
                "type": "array"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "context",
              "count",
              "offset",
              "quantities",
              "reference_states",
              "next"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "Required complete records do not fit the fixed document allowance.",
            "properties": {
              "context": {
                "description": "Exact context, retained even when no record can be copied.",
                "pattern": "^blake3:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$",
                "type": "string",
                "x-pse-identity": "ContentHash"
              },
              "kind": {
                "const": "unavailable",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "reason": {
                "description": "Explicit reason; narrowing the selection may make it readable.",
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "context",
              "reason"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          }
        ]
      },
      "PhysicalInspectionQueryOutput": {
        "description": "Physical names are package-declared names, never global aliases.",
        "oneOf": [
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "All quantities in the selected context, paged without cloning its inventory.",
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "const": "quantities",
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "One exact quantity and optionally its admitted representation conversion.",
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "description": "Complete physical quantity identity.",
                "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
                "type": "string",
                "x-pse-identity": "QuantityTypeId"
              },
              "kind": {
                "const": "quantity",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "unit": {
                "description": "Representation unit; absent selects the canonical unit.",
                "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ],
                "x-pse-identity": "UnitId"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "id",
              "unit"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "One exact declared quantity name.",
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "const": "quantity_named",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "name": {
                "description": "Declared physical-document name, case sensitive.",
                "maxLength": 1024,
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "name"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "One exact declared reference-state name.",
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "const": "reference_state_named",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "name": {
                "description": "Declared physical-document name, case sensitive.",
                "maxLength": 1024,
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "name"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          }
        ]
      },
      "PhysicalInspectionRequestBodyOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "A bounded query against one immutable physical context.",
        "properties": {
          "limit": {
            "description": "One through sixteen declarations; encoded output is at most 64 KiB.",
            "format": "uint",
            "maximum": 16,
            "minimum": 1,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "offset": {
            "description": "Original declaration offset in semantic identity order.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "query": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/PhysicalInspectionQueryOutput",
            "description": "Exact declared identity/name selection."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "query",
          "offset",
          "limit"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "PhysicalQuantityDescription": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Original selected quantity and its complete physical interpretation.",
        "properties": {
          "basis": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/PhysicalBasis"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Exact original basis and its composition/rate/reference conventions."
          },
          "basis_reference_state": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ReferenceState"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual reference conditions required by a standard-volume or similar basis."
          },
          "canonical_unit": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Unit",
            "description": "Original canonical representation."
          },
          "offset_to_canonical": {
            "description": "Admitted conversion offset; difference quantities retain zero here.",
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "quantity": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/QuantityType",
            "description": "Exact original type including basis, datum, scale, shape and subject."
          },
          "quantity_kind": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/QuantityKind",
            "description": "What is measured, including exact rational dimension and arithmetic convention."
          },
          "reference_state": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ReferenceState"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Exact original datum, including typed reference conditions."
          },
          "representation_unit": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Unit",
            "description": "Selected representation; raw result values are never changed by inspection."
          },
          "scale_to_canonical": {
            "description": "Admitted conversion multiplier to canonical magnitude.",
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "shape": {
            "description": "Declared ordered axis kinds.",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/PhysicalEntityKind"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "subject": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/PhysicalEntityKind"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Declared subject kind."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "quantity",
          "quantity_kind",
          "canonical_unit",
          "representation_unit",
          "scale_to_canonical",
          "offset_to_canonical",
          "basis",
          "basis_reference_state",
          "reference_state",
          "shape",
          "subject"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "QuantityAdditionKind": {
        "enum": [
          "additive",
          "origin_sensitive"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "QuantityKind": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "What is measured, independent of basis and datum.",
        "properties": {
          "addition_kind": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/QuantityAdditionKind",
            "description": "Additive or origin-sensitive arithmetic."
          },
          "category": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/QuantityKindCategory"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Discrete category of a dimensionless pure-number kind; `None` for a measured kind."
          },
          "definition": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/KindDefinition"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "`None` for a base kind; a derived kind's declaration, its monomial expanded to\ncanonical base-kind factors at admission."
          },
          "dimension": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/DimensionVector",
            "description": "SI exponents; this alone never resolves a physical type. A derived kind's\ndimension is derived from its monomial at admission."
          },
          "extensive": {
            "description": "Whether values scale with system size.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "id": {
            "description": "Registry identity.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "QuantityKindId"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "dimension",
          "extensive",
          "addition_kind",
          "category",
          "definition"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "QuantityKindCategory": {
        "enum": [
          "count",
          "indicator"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "QuantityType": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "A registered physical type and its canonical storage unit.",
        "properties": {
          "canonical_unit": {
            "description": "Canonical unit of the package.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "UnitId"
          },
          "id": {
            "description": "Registry identity.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "QuantityTypeId"
          },
          "key": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/QuantityTypeKey",
            "description": "The complete semantic key."
          },
          "name": {
            "description": "The name packages address it by, declared once in the physical document and unique\nwithin it (ADR-0123 Outcome 6).",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "nominal_magnitude": {
            "description": "Positive finite default scaling magnitude, if declared.",
            "format": "double",
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "name",
          "key",
          "canonical_unit",
          "nominal_magnitude"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "QuantityTypeKey": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Components that determine one registered physical type.",
        "properties": {
          "basis": {
            "description": "Optional material basis.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "x-pse-identity": "BasisId"
          },
          "kind": {
            "description": "The measured quantity kind.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": "string",
            "x-pse-identity": "QuantityKindId"
          },
          "reference_state": {
            "description": "Optional datum.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "x-pse-identity": "ReferenceStateId"
          },
          "scale_kind": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ScaleKind",
            "description": "Point or difference semantics."
          },
          "shape": {
            "description": "Ordered domain kinds.",
            "items": {
              "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
              "type": "string",
              "x-pse-identity": "EntityKindId"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "subject_kind": {
            "description": "Optional subject obligation; absent and explicit `none` stay distinct.",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$",
            "type": [
              "string",

      "Ratio": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "A rational exponent in canonical reduced form (blueprint §4.4 `pse.dimension_vector`).\n\nThe invariant is total: `den > 0`, `gcd(|num|, den) == 1`, and zero is exactly `0/1`.\nConstruction goes through [`Ratio::new`] or [`Ratio::from_parts`], both of which reject\nanything else, and deserialization re-validates. Two `Ratio`s are equal exactly when\nthey are the same rational number.\n\n`Ord` is the lexicographic order of the canonical `(num, den)` pair, not numeric order:\nit exists so that a `Ratio` can key a `BTreeMap` deterministically. Compare magnitudes\nwith [`Ratio::checked_sub`] and [`Ratio::is_zero`] rather than with `<`.\n\n```\nuse pse_quantity::Ratio;\n\nassert_eq!(Ratio::new(2, 4)?, Ratio::new(1, 2)?);\nassert_eq!(Ratio::new(-1, -2)?, Ratio::new(1, 2)?);\nassert_eq!(Ratio::new(0, 5)?, Ratio::ZERO);\nassert!(Ratio::new(1, 0).is_err());\n# Ok::<(), pse_quantity::DimensionError>(())\n```",
        "properties": {
          "den": {
            "format": "int16",
            "maximum": 32767,
            "minimum": -32768,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "num": {
            "format": "int16",
            "maximum": 32767,
            "minimum": -32768,
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "num",
          "den"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
```

### `telemetry_profile_capture` — Capture an explicitly selected native telemetry suspect

Exposure: **tool**. Owner: `pse.diagnostics.read_checkpoint + capture + CaptureSession.wait/stop`. Declaration source: [scripts/capabilities/telemetry_profiles.py](https://github.com/paul-heyse/pse-arrow/blob/main/scripts/capabilities/telemetry_profiles.py).

```json
{
  "description": "Associate a selected bounded telemetry observation with an explicit original native CaptureRequest and CheckpointIdentity. Start only the requested finite Timeline/CPU capture against its exact checkpoint/OperationId, then return the intact original CaptureDocument. The original native owner validates operation/liveness; preflight and postcheck preserve process/start association but are not atomic expected-identity admission. Elapsed telemetry time is not CPU time, and late attachment cannot recover preceding samples. Cancelling this attached helper drains capture only; it never cancels or restarts science, starts telemetry services, changes permissions/tuning or launches a profiler UI. Existing output directories refuse. Capture failure, symbols, overlap and loss remain independent of scientific outcomes.",
  "domain": "diagnostics",
  "effects": "Explicit bounded native Timeline/CPU capture and fresh retained output only; native capture owns samplers/exporters and drains them independently of target science.",
  "exposure": "tool",
  "family": "active-diagnostics",
  "guides": [
    "diagnostics"
  ],
  "id": "telemetry_profile_capture",
  "invocation_lifetime": "single",
  "owner": "pse.diagnostics.read_checkpoint + capture + CaptureSession.wait/stop",
  "prerequisites": [
    "Compatible prepared correctness extension and the exact original checkpoint identity/OperationId. Selected CPU capture additionally needs the existing native perf/Samply permissions and tools; none are installed or permission-tuned by this action."
  ],
  "reason": "",
  "requirements": [
    {
      "kind": "python-extension",
      "mode": "native",

        "python_extension_native_stage"
      ],
      "provider": null,
      "validated": true
    }
  ],
  "route": [],

  "title": "Capture an explicitly selected native telemetry suspect",
  "work_owner": null,
  "worker_calls": [

      "operation": "telemetry_profile_capture",
      "worker": "native"
    }
  ],
  "workflows": [
    "diagnose-run"
  ]
}
```

```json
    "$defs": {
      "CaptureKind": {

        "properties": {
          "output_exhausted": {
            "description": "The retained output allowance ended collection.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "queued_packets_dropped": {
            "description": "Lifecycle packets refused by the bounded optional caller-composed layer.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "refused_items": {

            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },

            "description": "CPU sampling inherits newly created threads and forked tasks, beyond published thread IDs.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "sampling_loss_unknown": {
            "description": "CPU kernel loss was not quantified by this adapter; never silently reported as zero.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "sampling_overlap_possible": {
            "description": "Independently attached related processes may duplicate inherited samples; never sum them.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "source_partial": {
            "description": "At least one owner checkpoint reported observation or thread loss.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "unknown_clock": {
            "description": "Some actual-time facts could not align to the same-host clock and were omitted.",
            "type": "boolean"
          }

{
```
```json
  "description": "Read a selected dirty-path page using explicit task/worker ownership claims bound to current source_sha256 and optional diff_sha256.
```
